description: ALTER TASK SET / UNSET / MODIFY and ALTER STREAM UNSET COMMENT through the SQL surface (SHOW TASKS cells, SHOW PARAMETERS IN TASK rows, SHOW STREAMS): SET SCHEDULE/WAREHOUSE, multiple options in one statement, task parameters, UNSET resetting to defaults (comment to the empty string, timeout to the 1-hour default), MODIFY AS changing the body and MODIFY WHEN the condition, RESUME/SUSPEND still working, stream SET/UNSET COMMENT, and UNSET SCHEDULE clearing it to NULL. Converted 1:1 from features/AlterTaskStreamActionsTest (now retired).
